class _RevalidatingStaticFiles(StaticFiles):
    """Static files that the browser re-checks on every load (cheap: 304 when unchanged).

    Without this, a browser may keep serving an old kav1.js for days after an update, and the
    new pages then break. (Found the hard way.)"""

    async def get_response(self, path, scope):
        response = await super().get_response(path, scope)
        response.headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache"
        return response
